'''Anomalus''' is the third boss of [[Tower of Karazhan]]. An avatar of pure magic,<ref name="Twitter">[https://x.com/turtlewowteam/status/1819688372861907427 Turtle WoW Team on Twitter] (2024-08-03)</ref> it is a result of the wild leylines stirring, taking form as a living force driven by vengeance.<ref>[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=b7z-yAdPchQ FACE DESOLATION: Tower of Karazhan Raid Trailer | Turtle WoW Vanilla+]</ref> If not contained, Anomalus threatens to damage the leylines across [[Azeroth]], and Karazhan itself may crumble to dust.<ref name="Twitter" />
